name: Nike KD 6 'Brazil'
story_html: The Nike KD 6 'Brazil' revives a 2014 colorway of Kevin Durant's sixth signature shoe. The low-profile silhouette features a black synthetic upper with a speckled multicolor Swoosh outlined in bright green trim along the lateral forefoot. The vibrant emerald hue makes repeat appearances on the textile collar lining and rubber outsole. Performance benefits include a lightweight Phylon midsole with responsive Zoom Air cushioning in the forefoot and an exposed Air-Sole unit in the heel.
